messages:
Jess: hey folks — opened PR #981 to tidy a couple of naming/lint nits (renamed userID -> user_id across auth & tests). CI passes locally but GH showed two lint warnings. PTAL when you have a sec: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/981
Sam: will take a quick look in ~30m
ci-bot: CI: unit tests passed. flake8 reported 2 warnings in auth/handler.py: E225 (missing whitespace) and N806 (argument name should be lowercase)
Jay: N806 typically means a parameter is capitalized. can you paste the snippet?
Jess: sure — here's the offending bit:
```python
def get_user_info(UserID):
    # look up by id
    return db.get(UserID)
```
I'll change to `user_id`. also noticed a trailing whitespace on the return line.
Maria: small style note — we prefer snake_case for function args; class names stay PascalCase. if this is a helper fn, `user_id` is the right choice.
Sam: LGTM after that rename. one more tiny nit: `ctxUser` appears in the auth middleware, can we rename to `ctx_user` for consistency? not a blocker.
Jess: yep, good catch. I'll make both changes and push a follow-up commit. do you all want me to squash into the original or leave as follow-up? I can squash to keep history tidy.
Jay: squash is fine with me.
Maria: no objections. no changelog needed for a rename-only PR.
Jess: pushed changes and force-pushed a squashed commit. re-running CI.
ci-bot: CI: lint passed, tests passed ✅
Sam: approved :+1:
Jay: approved — merging now :shipit:
Jess: thanks everyone! I'll watch the prod deploy logs and follow up if anything odd shows up.
